window.sentence: 01 Jan 2021 – 31 Dec 2025: 18 harmonized hotspot-days, 0.3× the 2005–2024 median for the same dates (71); rank 19 of 21 years, far below normal.

current.sentence: December 1–31, 2025: no harmonized hotspots detected, as in most past years.

report_card.text: MODIS missed many of the small fires in this area; pre-2012 values are unreliable here.
